user.title: Set up Weather Image
user.description: Install the Weather Image integration and enable the `weather_image.generate` service. No additional configuration is required here.

abort.already_configured: Weather Image has already been added.

generate.name: Generate weather image
generate.description: Render a PNG weather infographic using a Home Assistant weather entity and the weather.get_forecasts action.

entity_id.name: Weather entity
entity_id.description: The weather entity to render, for example weather.openweathermap.

forecast_type.name: Forecast type
forecast_type.description: Choose whether the bottom forecast rail uses daily or hourly forecast data.

title.name: Title
title.description: Optional title shown in the top-left of the card. When omitted, the entity name is used.

output_file.name: Output file
output_file.description: PNG output path inside /config/www. The default is /config/www/weather/latest.png.
